column_description: VARCHAR(50) PRIMARY KEY uniquely identifying each alert record.
UUID REFERENCES Plant(GrowRegistry), referencing which plant component triggered the alert.
VARCHAR(50) REFERENCES Panel(PaneMark), linking alert to a specific panel if needed.
VARCHAR(50) REFERENCES Performance(PerfRegistry), linking alert to performance data if relevant.
TIMESTAMP logging when the alert was generated (e.g., '2023-07-20 14:05:00').
VARCHAR(50) summarizing the alert’s status or severity (was 'AlertStatus'). Possible enumerations: 'Warning', 'Critical'.
SMALLINT counting how many times this alert occurred (was 'AlertCount') (e.g., 3).
VARCHAR(50) describing the maintenance priority (was 'MaintenancePriority'). Possible enumerations: 'High', 'Medium', 'Low'.
VARCHAR(50) indicating the replacement priority (was 'ReplacementPriority'). Possible enumerations: 'High', 'Medium', 'Low'.
VARCHAR(100) reflecting any optimization potential (was 'OptimizationPotential'). Possible enumerations: 'Medium', 'High', 'Low'.
